First and most importantly, e-forms, PDF creation, data entry. For each monitored client, they have a contract that links directly to their account number. 
This information is vital for each customer. I am aware that you have similar fields, however I cannot have multiple sites per single client. I must create new parent/child accounts.

 

Under the service / contracts tab, I can see the recurring contract. What I cannot see, and this is what is fundamental, what system number that contract is assigned to. Under my customer / service / contract tab, contact 1418 is assigned to me. However, when I open it, I cannot see system number (01-08-7609), zoning (22 active monitored zones with various levels of action patterns), or keyholders (who to call in an emergency).

 

The backbone of every single alarm company is the recurring services. Each recurring service needs to have the keyholder and zoning information. This is essential for communication with the client, but more importantly, the central station. If there is a life safety device triggered, they need to know who to call, where the call came from, and what zone was triggered. Right now, with the current way REV.IO works, I would have to re-type all that information into a custom PDF to send to my station to build. This would be a major duplication of work that I will not do when my current software is built for that purpose.

 

With my current software, I can create customized forms that pull data from the customer, site, and system tabs. Every single variable that I can enter under any of those tabs can then be pulled automatically into an e-form that I can download.

 

Additionally, when a customer needs an insurance certificate to indicate coverage, I should be able to export that same zoning list to a new custom form to automatically email the customer.

E-forms are the easiest way to pull data from any data point on the customer, site, and system and put into one convenient PDF. Right now, I used e-forms for: collecting payment information securely, contracts that are NOT attached with a quote/proposal, contracts for 3rd party monitoring providers, insurance certificates, parts packing list for job boxes, and system updates to the central station. While your system can ask clients to choose their preferred option between a and b, that does not outweigh the additional features we would need.

 

When invoicing a client, the invoicing parameters are not customisable enough. Each invoice needs my company operating name, legal name, address, and HST (tax) number. For commercial clients, I also need a field for a purchase order number. Right now, you can choose memo OR address of the company. This does not work for me. Taxes cannot be included with surcharges. When you look at charges, even for non-recurring items you have a start and end date. I can say with a high percent of certainty that almost every client will call me asking why.
